name: The Shooting Star Addition
description: An unofficial addon for The Shooting Star. Adds SS-05 Halley and SS-06 Luna to the Stellar Remote. SS-05: a comet called down onto your crosshair. It comes in low over the horizon, ploughs a frozen trench toward your mark and detonates on it, leaving an icy crater with the comet's glowing heart standing in it. SS-06: at night the moon itself falls on your crosshair and stays there, a moon of edible moon cheese with a molten heart. Made for The Shooting Star (Demo) 1.3.3 and newer (tested with 1.3.4) on Fabric 26.3.
